_comment: Copy for the landing-page greeting. A random 'welcome' types in and erases, then a matching 'rule' or random 'generic' line types in and stays. The fixed 'identity' appears below. 'invites' are available but not currently displayed. Rules are checked top-to-bottom; first match wins. Put specific cities above broad regions. Keep location references tentative because IP geolocation can be wrong. Generic lines must work without location context. Keep the tone casual, with occasional dry humor. Placeholders: {city}, {region}, {country}. Match fields: cities[] (case-insensitive), regionCodes[] (US unless scoped with country), countryCodes[]. Loaded by lib/greetingConfig.ts.
identity: CS + Math @ WashU, focused on distributed systems and robotics. prev SWE @ Tesla, Capital One, and Spectrum.
